prompt: In HubSpot, find the support ticket titled “Login Credentials Not Working for First-Time Setup - Laura Mitchell”. Add a note to that ticket owned by Sarah Kim with the subject “Laura Mitchell login blocker follow-up” and body “Confirmed this is blocking onboarding. Please prioritize credential reset and update Laura Mitchell today.”
verifier:
def validate_task(env, final_answer: str | None = None) -> int:
    TASK_FAILED_SCORE = 0
    TASK_SUCCESSFUL_SCORE = 1

    error_accumulator = []
    success_accumulator = []

    env.instance.load()
    seed = env.db("seed")
    current = env.db("current")

    def find_new_entries(table_name, id_field="id", filter_conditions=None):
        """Compare seed vs current to find rows added by the agent."""
        before_query = seed.table(table_name)
        after_query = current.table(table_name)
        if filter_conditions:
            for key, value in filter_conditions.items():
                before_query = before_query.eq(key, value)
                after_query = after_query.eq(key, value)
        before_ids = set(entry[id_field] for entry in before_query.select(id_field).all())
        return [e for e in after_query.all() if e[id_field] not in before_ids]

    target_ticket_name = "Login Credentials Not Working for First-Time Setup - Laura Mitchell"
    expected_owner_name = "Sarah Kim"
    expected_subject = "Laura Mitchell login blocker follow-up"
    expected_body = "Confirmed this is blocking onboarding. Please prioritize credential reset and update Laura Mitchell today."

    seed_ticket = seed.table("entries").eq("name", target_ticket_name).first()
    current_ticket = current.table("entries").eq("name", target_ticket_name).first()

    if not seed_ticket or not current_ticket:
        error_accumulator.append("[X] Target ticket was not found in seed/current database")
        print(">>> ERROR_ACCUMULATOR >>>")
        print(error_accumulator)
        print("<<< ERROR_ACCUMULATOR <<<")
        return TASK_FAILED_SCORE

    if current_ticket["type"] == "ticket":
        success_accumulator.append("[C] Target ticket exists and is a ticket")
    else:
        error_accumulator.append("[X] Target record exists but is not a ticket")

    owner = current.table("users").eq("display_name", expected_owner_name).first()
    if not owner:
        error_accumulator.append("[X] Expected owner Sarah Kim was not found")
        print(">>> ERROR_ACCUMULATOR >>>")
        print(error_accumulator)
        print("<<< ERROR_ACCUMULATOR <<<")
        return TASK_FAILED_SCORE

    new_activities = find_new_entries("activities")
    if not new_activities:
        error_accumulator.append("[X] No new engagement/activity was created")
    else:
        success_accumulator.append("[C] At least one new activity was created")

    matching_activities = []
    for activity in new_activities:
        activity_type = (activity.get("activity_type") or "").lower()
        subject = activity.get("subject") or ""
        body = activity.get("body") or ""
        if (
            activity_type == "note"
            and activity.get("owner_id") == owner["id"]
            and subject == expected_subject
            and expected_body in body
        ):
            matching_activities.append(activity)

    if matching_activities:
        success_accumulator.append("[C] Created the requested note with the correct owner, subject, and body")
    else:
        error_accumulator.append("[X] Did not find a newly created note owned by Sarah Kim with the requested subject and body")

    if matching_activities:
        matching_activity_ids = {activity["id"] for activity in matching_activities}
        new_links = find_new_entries("entries_activities")
        linked_activity_ids = {
            link["activity_id"]
            for link in new_links
            if link.get("entry_id") == current_ticket["id"]
        }

        if matching_activity_ids.intersection(linked_activity_ids):
            success_accumulator.append("[C] The new note is associated with the Laura Mitchell login ticket")
        else:
            error_accumulator.append("[X] The matching note was not associated with the target ticket")

    if error_accumulator:
        print(">>> ERROR_ACCUMULATOR >>>")
        print(error_accumulator)
        print("<<< ERROR_ACCUMULATOR <<<")
        if success_accumulator:
            print(">>> SUCCESS_ACCUMULATOR >>>")
            print(success_accumulator)
            print("<<< SUCCESS_ACCUMULATOR <<<")
        return TASK_FAILED_SCORE

    print(">>> SUCCESS_ACCUMULATOR >>>")
    print(success_accumulator)
    print("<<< SUCCESS_ACCUMULATOR <<<")
    return TASK_SUCCESSFUL_SCORE
